reply_text:
I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest from here. I don't have a scheduling tool in this session, so nothing will arrive automatically tomorrow.

What I can do: you're in #coastal-team, so when you ask me in this DM, I'll read that channel and send you a "Coastal team digest" of anything new since the last one. If you'd rather have it automatic, someone with scheduling access will need to set up the 09:00 job.
